changes.title: Dress before door
items: The bedroom curtains open by themselves once the island has loaded, unlocking the door
The bedroom is bigger, with everything you can wear except your hat, bag and broom in it, so you can get dressed before the door opens
Hats, bags and brooms are in the shared rooms past the door (there'll be a bedroom each when friends join)

changes.title: Trunks
items: Each night an old travel trunk lies somewhere in the forest, half-sunk under the trees, with something new to wear inside: open it with E while the party's on and it's yours to keep
The crystal ball in the treehouse shows what tonight's trunk holds and which way it lies

changes.title: Opening default
items: The game now starts on the sea chart: sail home to wake in your bedroom in the treehouse (add ?opening=old to the link for the old start)
